Short Name: Dividend history missing interest and withdrawals
Description: The dividend history we loaded under Issue 114 does not add up to the balance QLAdmin shows at the bottom of the same screen. One policy lists $4,610.10 of dividends against a balance of $9,220.33; another lists $5,409.60 against a balance of $4,020.04. The gap runs both ways. The reason is that Issue 114 loaded only the dividends themselves, but QLAdmin's dividend history is meant to be a complete running account — dividends in, interest earned on the money left there, and anything withdrawn.
Notes: Fixed in v58.37 and validated. Dividend history now includes interest earned and money taken out of the accumulation account, so the history adds up to the balance on the screen. 55 of 59 policies with a dividend balance now match exactly. Three policies still do not match, and they are left alone on purpose. On those three, LifePRO shows more dividends credited over the life of the policy than the current balance can explain, which means some of that money left the account before 2018. Our accounting extract only goes back to 2018, so we cannot see what happened — a withdrawal, a payout, or a change of dividend option. Guessing would put the wrong transaction on the history. The three are: 9010382426 (history $6,148.50 vs balance $4,020.04, short $2,128.46 — this is the policy from the original review), 9010457623 (history $2,596.38 vs balance $1.53, short $2,594.85), and 9010497768 (history $2,053.12 vs balance $263.20, short $1,789.92). LifePRO's own dividend history for those three would settle it. Everything else on the table is unchanged, including the Issue 114 dividend amounts.
